lines.beaver_en: Hello, this is customer service. How can I help you?
lines.en: I'd like to return the earphones I bought last week.

lines.beaver_en: Okay, how long ago did you purchase them?
lines.learner: 구매한 지 일주일 됐어요. 배송은 월요일에 받았어요.
lines.en: It's been a week. The delivery came on Monday.
lines.roman: gumaehan ji iljuil dwaesseoyo. baesongeun woryoire badasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: May I ask why you're returning them?
lines.en: Yesterday I saw the price was cut to half.

lines.beaver: 아, 네. 신제품이 나와서 반값 행사 중이에요.
lines.beaver_en: Ah, yes. A new product came out, so there's a half-price sale.
lines.beaver_roman: a, ne. sinjepumi nawaseo bangap haengsa jungieyo.
lines.en: Ah, I see. That's why I was a bit upset.

lines.learner: 아니요, 포장을 뜯지 않은 채로 그대로 있어요.
lines.en: No, it's still unopened, just as it was.
lines.roman: aniyo, pojangeul tteutji aneun chaero geudaero isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Are there any scratches on the wrapping or box?
lines.learner: 네, 포장지도 처음 받은 채로 깨끗해요.
lines.en: No, the wrapping is clean, just as I got it.
lines.roman: ne, pojangjido cheoeum badeun chaero kkaekkeutaeyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 반품 가능합니다. 신제품으로 바꿔 드릴까요?
lines.beaver_en: Then a return is possible. Shall I exchange it for the new product?
lines.beaver_roman: geureom banpum ganeunghamnida. sinjepumeuro bakkwo deurilkkayo?
lines.en: No, I'll return it and buy it again at half price.

lines.beaver: 네, 좋습니다. 택배 기사님이 내일 방문하실 거예요.
lines.beaver_en: Okay. A courier will visit you tomorrow.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, jotseumnida. taekbae gisanimi naeil bangmunhasil geoyeyo.
lines.learner: 상자는 테이프를 붙인 채로 드리면 되나요?
lines.en: Can I hand over the box with tape on it?
lines.roman: sangjaneun teipeureul buchin chaero deurimyeon doenayo?

lines.beaver: 네, 받으신 상자에 넣은 채로 주시면 돼요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, just give it to them inside the box you received.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, badeusin sangjae neoeun chaero jusimyeon dwaeyo.
lines.learner: 알겠어요. 환불은 언제 받을 수 있어요?
lines.en: Got it. When can I get the refund?
lines.roman: algesseoyo. hwanbureun eonje badeul su isseoyo?

lines.beaver_en: You'll be refunded within three days after it arrives.
lines.en: Okay, thank you for your kind help.
